user.title: Connect to your K 40 RF
user.description: Enter the address of the gateway. It is the Connect-Key module in your heating system, and it must be reachable on your local network.

data_description.host: The gateway's IP address or hostname.

discovery_confirm.title: K 40 RF found
discovery_confirm.description: A gateway with the device ID {device_id} was found at {host}. Set it up now?

auth_method.title: How should Home Assistant connect?
auth_method.description:
Pairing asks the gateway at {host} for a token. That needs the password from the sticker, a button press on the device, and Home Assistant on the gateway's own network.

If you already have a token, or would rather not hand over the sticker password, paste the token instead. It is the only credential the integration stores.

menu_options.reauth_confirm: Pair again with the device password

credentials.title: Device credentials
credentials.description: Both values are printed on the sticker on your Connect-Key module.

data_description.username: The login from the sticker. It is the same number as in the device name.
data_description.password: The sticker password, in the form aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd. The dashes are optional.

proximity.title: Press the buttons on the gateway
proximity.description:
Press the WLAN and radio buttons on the gateway at {host} together for about a second, until the blue LED lights up. Then continue within five minutes.

The gateway only hands out a token to a device on its own network.

token.title: Existing token
token.description: Paste a bearer token for the gateway at {host}. The token does not expire, several can be valid at once, and the integration stores nothing besides it. The README shows how to obtain one.

data_description.token: The access_token from the gateway's /auth/token answer.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {host} no longer accepts the stored token. Enter the sticker password again to obtain a new one.

reconfigure.title: Change the gateway's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the address the gateway {device_id} is reachable at now. The stored token is used to check that it is still the same gateway.

data_description.host: The gateway's IP address or hostname.

error.proximity_required: The gateway refused: press the WLAN and radio buttons together for about a second, then try again straight away. This also fails if Home Assistant is not on the same network as the gateway.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected these credentials. Check the login and password on the sticker.
error.invalid_password_format: The password should look like aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway. Check the address and that it is switched on.
error.invalid_token: The gateway did not accept this token.
error.no_gateway_id: The gateway did not report its ID, so this token cannot be tied to a device. Pair with the device password instead.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.
abort.not_a_gateway: The discovered device is not a K 40 RF gateway.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This token belongs to a different gateway than the one being reconnected.

auth_failed.message: The gateway no longer accepts the stored token.
